responsibility: Defines low-level access to the representation and arithmetic properties of SHORTREAL, including builtin-provided limits, format flags, floating-point mode bits, and operations for decomposition, adjacent-value stepping, ulp computation, scaling, truncation, rounding, synthesis, and exception-status queries. It is the short-precision member of the gm2 ISO floating-point introspection family.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LowShort: it declares the low-level floating-point property and manipulation API for SHORTREAL values, while LowShort.mod contains the executable implementation for that precision.
